question.text: Which of the given compounds can enhance the efficiency of hydrogen storage tank?

solution.text: Dihydrogen gas is converted into liquid state by cooling to 20K. This would require expensive insulated tanks. Tanks are metal alloy like <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>NaNi</mi><mn>5</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>Ti</mi><mo>-</mo><msub><mi>TiH</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>Mg</mi><mo>-</mo><msub><mi>MgH</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo></mrow></msub></math> etc. are in use for storage of dihydrogen.
